findings.reason: Only the read/parse half of indexAll() is sliced; the commit still runs as one synchronous transaction proportional to project size. Pending the spec answer to dev-0002; becomes blocking if the writes must yield too.

indexAll() can now interleave with itself (overlapping projection rebuild) and with context teardown (db closed between slices). Consider serialising indexAll() calls (reuse the in-flight promise) and ending early when the context is disposed.
